browser: Playwright CLI Chromium with production release injection

runtimeValidation.method: npm run qa:prepare fetched both SHA-256-pinned startup files referenced by the promoted 2.13.10 userscript from the production custom origin; the combined payload was injected into real Luogu pages in Chromium

startupMeasurement.method: Measured synchronous execution of the prepared 2.13.10 QA payload in the browser main world
startupMeasurement.purpose: Bootstrap execution budget; production delivery and integrity were independently verified by the CDN production gate

productionCdn.productionGate: scripts/cdn/verify-production.mjs verified every immutable 2.13.10 file after deployment

practiceProblemColourScope.recycledAnchor: A coloured attempted anchor moved into the passed card lost its marker, inline style and wrapper within 100 ms

hiddenIntroRouteScope.spaHomeToPractice: introduction withdrawn after clicking the practice tab

console.summary: No console error was observed in the direct practice, problem-list, user-home, or SPA home-to-practice runs.

limitations: Chromium did not install Tampermonkey; the exact promoted userscript and both production startup files were injected after initial document load, so document-start restricted-page coverage was not repeated.
The browser session was signed out, so IDE batch execution, private-message Ctrl+Click, and authenticated /record/list behaviour remain covered by automated tests rather than this browser run.
Restricted article and paste recovery were not re-exercised; their behavior remains covered by the passing automated suite.
